Use case: stylized-concept. Create a beautiful polished cozy farm game PIXEL ART master sprite sheet, exactly 1536 x 1024 PNG with TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Six poses in 3 columns x 2 rows of exactly 512 x 512 cells, no grid lines or labels. No detail smaller than a block, no antialiasing, gradients, blur, glow, shadow, texture noise or backdrop. 1-block dark outline #231F2E, 2-3 shades per material, top-left light. Lovable book-illustration house-elves, never film CGI or actors. Beautiful expressive face, huge readable eyes with dark pupils and pale-white highlights using #D6D8BF or #B7DEE0 (not pure white), nuanced ears and warm smiles, clearly readable hands and carefully designed flat colour clusters. Adult characters about 64-70 blocks tall including ear/hat tips; same head/body proportions between poses. Body centered local x256, standing feet at y468, >=24px empty margin on every side including props. Three-quarter toward LOWER LEFT. Same head height for idle and two walks; walk1 clearly LEFT foot forward, walk2 clearly RIGHT foot forward, reversed arm swing and leg overlap. No extra characters, no text, no background. Palette must contain at most 16 EXACT colours chosen ONLY from #231F2E #4A3042 #735044 #A57554 #41465C #687486 #A6B1AE #D6D8BF #24483F #3F6A45 #71934B #B0BD67 #8B4A3F #C97952 #E7AE73 #F5D69A #874056 #C75B4B #ED8A45 #FFC36B #3E3B70 #6961A6 #70A8B6 #B7DEE0. Do not introduce other RGB shades.
